The '''''Defector''''' was an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] in service to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
The ''Defector'' was an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]]<ref name="Showdown" /> built by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. 300 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long, the ''Defector'' was armed with twelve [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser batteries]], twelve [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], and two [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] projectors. A crew of 854 beings operated the ship, alongside sixty-six [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]], although a skeleton crew of 307 with ten gunners could run the ship if necessary. Equipped with [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] and a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]], the ''Defector'' was capable of [[Lightspeed/Legends|faster-than-light]] travel utilizing a Class 2 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], with a Class 12 backup unit. It was also able to travel at speeds of 800 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] in [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. The [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] could carry consumables to last two [[Standard year/Legends|years]], and had storage space for 6,000 [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]]. Seventy-five [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] could also be billeted aboard.<ref name="Stats" />

==History==
The ''Defector'' served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], assigned to the [[Trax Sector Force]]. Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it participated in the [[battle of Bissillirus]] alongside the [[DP20 gunship/Legends|DP20 frigates]] [[Corellian Thunder (DP20 gunship)|''Corellian Thunder'']] and ''[[Dream Runner]]''.<ref name="Showdown" />
